statement: The government of Iran submits or publicly announces formal withdrawal from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if Iran files a withdrawal notice under NPT Article X or a wire service (Reuters, AP, AFP) reports such an announcement, dated between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-30; else FALSE.
failure_condition: No NPT withdrawal notice or wire-service-confirmed withdrawal announcement from Iran appears inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A New York state court issues any order or ruling, including on a preliminary motion, in the business-group lawsuit against the city-owned grocery store initiative, between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the case docket in the New York court e-filing system shows a judicial order or ruling entered between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-30 in this case; FALSE if no order is entered.
failure_condition: The court docket shows no order or ruling entered in the case inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A named law-enforcement agency (Europol, FBI, or a national police force) announces additional arrests connected to the global cybercrime crackdown, between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-08.
resolution: TRUE if Europol, the FBI, or a national police agency issues a press release naming additional arrests tied to this operation, dated 2026-08-26 through 2026-09-08; FALSE if no such release appears.
failure_condition: No named law-enforcement agency issues a release announcing further arrests tied to this operation inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class

statement: GDACS raises tropical cyclone JULIO-26 from Green to Orange or Red alert level before the system is marked dissipated, between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-08.
resolution: TRUE if the GDACS event page for JULIO-26 shows an Orange or Red alert level at any point between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-08; FALSE if it stays Green or is closed without upgrade.
failure_condition: The GDACS alert level for JULIO-26 never exceeds Green before the window closes or the system dissipates.
